oracle.method: host-side reconstruction of the deterministic Lepton fixture (slow gradient + warm block + cool block) from frame-seed, FNV-1a over the 160x120 big-endian byte stream

matrix.note: kernel lane added for committed bare-metal probe ELFs; see platform/tests

probe_evidence.note: vsync count is a free-running reference-pulse counter and varies with wall time; frames, segments, packets, digests and the panel screenshot are deterministic across runs

official_firmware_black_box.name: StickT2 User Demo
official_firmware_black_box.layout: bootloader 0x1000, partition table 0x8000, ota_0 0x10000/1536000, ota_1 0x190000/1536000; app segments end 0x78144; region ~0x78000-0x100000 is non-0xFF and does not belong to any partition (documented as unexplained bytes, not interpreted)

run.result: the factory image boots through ROM/bootloader to the app marker after the classic UART TX_DONE latch fix; no Lepton CCI command or VoSPI packet read was observed within the 150 s deterministic run window, and the image has no MicroPython filesystem so it cannot be probe-injected
